claims.text: Experiments are conducted to validate theoretical insights against real scenarios, using a Transformer architecture with specific configurations.
The training and validation sets for the IWSLT14 German-to-English task consist of approximately 153K and 7K sentence pairs, respectively, using a vocabulary of 10K tokens.
Experiments involve pre-training on English Wikipedia and BookCorpus, with a training-validation ratio of 199:1.
The performance of models is evaluated using validation loss and BLEU scores during experiments.
